notes: 16 clubs, 30-round double round-robin, bottom three (14th-16th) relegated directly. The replacements come from League 2: its two best clubs plus a play-off winner, which is how JS El Biar, US Biskra and CR Temouchent came up for 2026-27. League 2 is regionalised and is not in our rows, so it is not modelled and the league is closed downwards in our data; there is no promotion/relegation play-off involving a Ligue 1 club. No cups or CAF places included.
